app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: The best app for people who need flexibility in their planning
body:
This app is seriously the most AWESOME tool ever. The different time-based and goal-based options mean that I don’t even have to have multiple apps for this. I can put all my reminders in one place. I basically deleted off three other apps that I had on my phone, because this one handles all of them, and looks prettier doing them, too (shallow, I know, but it’s so cleaaaaaaan!)

 I’m flipping out over how stylish and minimalistic the app is, too. It’s so pleasant to look at and go through. I’ve used so many of these kind of apps before, and their interfaces and restricted options would eventually limit my use of them. Neither of these issues here. 5/5 recommend!
author: Yezray
